description: This file defines the DevOpsErrorResponse class, which represents an error response in the DevOps command framework. It encapsulates details of a runtime exception in JSON form and provides methods for creating, parsing, and manipulating such error response objects within the broader Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DevOpsErrorResponse
classes.description: Represents an error response wrapping a runtime exception for DevOps commands, providing JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and builder methods.

methods.name: DevOpsErrorResponse.of
methods.description: Creates a new DevOpsErrorResponse instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: DevOpsErrorResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a DevOpsErrorResponse from a JSON string or JSON object, including error handling.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the runtime exception.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource, which is empty in this implementation.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name associated with this error response, if available.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the instance identifier associated with this error response, if available.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the error response payload to a JSON builder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new DevOpsErrorResponse with the given DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the object's properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this object and another.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equals to verify class compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new error response with the given JSON entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON entity representing the error.
